purpose: Replace exact Gold CSS and DOM assertions with deterministic rendered-behavior contracts.
contract_changes: Title and logo use visibility, emphasis, separation, and bounded-size checks instead of exact CSS constants.
A hidden aggregate caption is accepted; bundle facts and visual hierarchy are checked independently of exact child count and margins.
Top-level colors use distinct computed RGB values and WCAG contrast; parent-child depth uses hue and lightness relationships without exact Gold HSL constants.
Selected-bundle details and preservation of the report-wide header total are separate tests.
The resource table is checked for semantic headings, minimum row count, fixture leaves, and a formatted size without fixing row order or exact DOM tags.
